Six words Hand, Leg, Eyes, Nose, Mouth and Ear are written on different faces of a
dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the word on the face
opposite to Hand.
Ans
1. Ear
2. Nose
3. Mouth
4. Leg
